prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animated transparent PNG sprites for the isometric Halloween action game Trick or Treat Maple Falls.
Input image 1 is ONLY a framing/feet-anchor and rough motion guide (do NOT copy its crude blob anatomy); input image 2 is the painting style, lighting and 3/4 camera reference.
Create a square 1536x1536 sprite atlas with exactly 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, 12 isolated full-body sprites. Cell size384x512. Row1 boss: Original imposing pale hive cyborg, half-porcelain face fused with asymmetric black industrial implants, one emerald scanning lens, thick corrugated cables, dark biomechanical armor and a mechanical claw hand, no franchise insignia or actor likeness. Row2 smaller follower A: Pale assimilated worker drone with asymmetric dark face implants, green optic and corrugated chest cables. Row3 smaller follower B: Small black armored hive cyborg with a green targeting lens and a broad mechanical tool arm.
Every row is FOUR animation frames of the SAME character, same identity, scale, costume, camera, lit from upper left amber with cool blue shadows. All face diagonally down/right towards viewer at the reference elevated isometric game camera, not straight front orthographic. Columns: neutral forward stride, left foot forward/arms shift, recoil/body bob, right foot forward/arms opposite; creatures use fins/tentacles/wings instead of feet. Distinct usable animation motion not duplicate illustrations. Camera does not rotate.
Anchor feet/pivot centered at x192 and y450 inside EACH cell. Boss fits inside x22..362 y75..472; minions inside x34..351 y86..498. Entire body and every accessory remain inside those margins with transparent padding. Hovering entities have their invisible ground pivot at y450. Keep large heads fully in frame even if rough guide is clipped. No environment, floor, shadows outside character, text, labels, grid lines, watermark or other monsters.
Rich detailed hand-painted spooky arcade fantasy game sprites matching image2; readable crisp outlines, warm material highlights, cool indigo shadows, NOT flat cartoon clipart. Genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside each sprite.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the edit target: an animated 12-sprite atlas of grey aliens. Image2 is the art/lighting reference. Keep the top TWO rows (8 alien sprites) exactly unchanged in design, framing, sizes and placement. Replace ONLY the bottom row's four probe-carrying grey alien technicians with four frames of a SAME small metallic flying saucer, glass dome with visible grey alien pilot, copper outer rim, emerald tractor-beam lens underneath and warm amber running lights. The whole saucer viewed elevated isometric 3/4 facing down/right, not a side-view circle. Native bottom row has 4 equal columns: same saucer identity/size/view in each; frame1 idle hover, frame2 subtle tilt/bob with rim lights on, frame3 emerald beam emitter powering, frame4 bob/recoil with rim lights shifted. Uniform four-frame motion cycle, not four different ships. Keep the existing bottom row spacing and transparent margins. No beam touching other sprites, no background, no shadow plate, no text/label/watermark. Match target's hand-painted dark fantasy Halloween painting, warm edge light and cool blue shadows. Genuine alpha transparency.
